README.md

cloud-u-containers_cgc

🐧 Unix 1 › ☁️ Cloudy 1.1 › Linux 1.1.3 › Linux Containers 1.1.3.1

Public half of the cgc code knowledge graph pipeline: octocode indexes of the public repos -> GHCR -> cloud-cgc-pub-mcp. Split out of cloud-u-containers / cloud-infra.

CodeVisibilityHubDeveloperFarm folder
1.1.3.1.2🌐 publiccloudy-___ 1.1.0Leaf.y1.1.Cloudy/

The public half of the cgc code knowledge graph pipeline: octocode indexes of the public repos of diegonmarcos, published per repo to ghcr.io/diegonmarcos/cgc-db-<repo>:latest and served by the cloud-cgc-pub-mcp MCP server. Split out of cloud-infra and cloud-u-containers (split-outs are named <parent>_<name>).

  • .github/workflows/cgc-db.yml: pub orchestrator (semantic, then graphrag), twice daily.
  • .github/workflows/cgc-db-index.yml: reusable index phase, one matrix job per repo. Also called, pinned by sha, by the private orchestrator in cloud-me-pvt-cgc (private, cloud-me family; was cloud-u-containers_cgc-pvt).
  • 1_cicd/src/ops/: index, chunk planner, packaging, pull and restore scripts.
  • 9_others/test/: testers (sh 9_others/test/run-all.sh, needs diegonmarcos/cloudy-u-containers checked out at a_solutions/).
  • a0_docs/eng-specs/: cgc-public-private-split.md (how the surfaces are split, the safety audit, cutover) and cgc-incremental-chunked.md (how indexing works).

Only public repos are ever indexed from here: this repository's Actions logs are public. Config comes from user-ai_cloud-cgc-pub-mcp/build.json in cloud-u-containers.
